sql:
SELECT a.geo_name, a.median_household_income AS y14, b.median_household_income AS y25, c.median_household_income AS y97
FROM census.acs1_income a JOIN census.acs1_income b ON a.state=b.state AND b.year=2025
LEFT JOIN census.acs1_income c ON a.state=c.state AND c.year=2005
WHERE a.year=2014 AND a.state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.geo_name

WITH g AS (SELECT a.geo_name n, b.median_household_income*1.0/a.median_household_income/1.3599 - 1 AS real_g, b.median_household_income*1.0/c.median_household_income AS r0525 FROM census.acs1_income a JOIN census.acs1_income b ON a.state=b.state AND b.year=2025 JOIN census.acs1_income c ON a.state=c.state AND c.year=2005 WHERE a.year=2014 AND a.geo_name NOT IN ('Puerto Rico','District of Columbia')) SELECT n, real_g, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY real_g DESC) rk FROM g ORDER BY rk
